1. (Currently amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __other than radially displacing tissue along the path__.

2. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __selected from forceps, scissors, suction devices, or ablation probes__.

3. (Original): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __such that the device does not contact the outer surface of the brain__.

6. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the working channel open__.

7. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __by expanding a reinforcement structure independent of the initial expansion__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __wherein the medical element is introduced after the reinforcement structure is fully expanded__.

8. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __that is rigid and non-expandable__.

9. (Original): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

10. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __that are separated by at least 5 millimeters__.

11. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while the reinforcement structure remains in place__.

12. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __by applying the compound before radial expansion is initiated__.

13. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue __such that the stent achieves a diameter greater than the second expandable body__; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __wherein the medical element is introduced through the stent lumen__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __while the stent remains in place within the tissue__.

14. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __that is advanced through the stent without contacting the stent__.

15. (Original): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the second expandable body is positioned between the tissue layers__.

17. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __by applying the compound to the outer surface of the second expandable body__.
